notes.title: Update V1.031
notes.content:
Hi Folks.

Just a small update to fix a couple of minor bugs.

* [b]Fix[/b] - If a party has visited a level but none of them are currently on that level, the Jump Move button is highlighted and can be pressed but a jump move does not occur. Jump Move does not work between levels, so the button should not have been highlighted.

* [b]Fix[/b] - If the player casts a spell that targets their own units and a unit occupies a tile on another level that has the same tile number as the current level, the tile on the current level is highlighted even though there is no unit on it.

We hope you enjoy this update and please let us know if you encounter any problems.

All the best.

Ian & Jann

notes.title: Update V1.030
notes.content:
Hi All.

As promised in V1.026, we have just released an update to bring the movement options that were developed for Mystery at Morgoth (MaM) to The Curse. There is also a small bug fix included.

* [b]Jump Move[/b] - The party can immediately move to any point on the map it has previously visited. There are two new options in the [b]Interface Options[/b] dialog that control the behavior of jump moves (Jump Move Uses Real Time and Confirm Jump Move).

*** IMPORTANT NOTE *** This feature only works in a game that is in progress from the current position moving forward. Prior to this update the game will not have recorded which tiles your party has visited.

* [b]Swap Position[/b] - Player unit tokens can change position (marching order). Can be used at any time but very useful when in confined spaces. There is a new option in the [b]Player Options[/b] dialog that controls this behavior (Swap Position Consumes Action).

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39203125/c2b5ebf61be0e5beeb22da010c2c2809b8608f40.png[/img]

* [b]Fix:[/b] The achievements for Zombie Hunter and Zombie Slayer were not updating their score correctly.

There will be more MaM features to come in future updates. Stay tuned!

We have found during testing that the two new features above, significantly enhance movement during the non-combat parts of the game.

We hope you enjoy this upgrade and please let us know if you encounter any problems.

All the best.

Ian & Jann

notes.title: Update V1.029
notes.content:
Hi Folks.

Just a small update to introduce a new feature requested by the Community, a game play improvement and fixes for some minor issues that we have uncovered while developing The Dark Tower.

[list]
[*][b]New Advanced Rule[/b]: Experience Balance. Only applies if 'AI Hit Point Bonus' is not zero. Adjusts the experience received from melee and ranged attacks so that characters receive the same XPs as when there is no adjustment to the AI unit's hit points.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41127921/c69f70554aa2c392e9efb50e156231851a594834.png[/img]

This means that your units will level up at roughly the same speed regardless of the AI Hit Point Bonus.

[*][b]Change[/b]: If a unit resists a spell due to its Magic Resistance attribute, the text "Magic Resistance" will float above the unit.
[/list]

Due to changes in Steam's platform support, we have upgraded The Curse to run as a 64-bit executable only.

Please let us know if you have any problems with the update and we hope you enjoy the game.

All the best.

Ian & Jann

notes.title: Update V1.026
notes.content:
Hi All.

We have just released a really big update to add a number of improvements that we have developed in The Mystery at Morgoth (MaM). All the bug fixes that been identified in MaM over the last few months have also been included.

* [b]New Feature:[/b] The game will now automatically create a Saved Game when the player wins. This is so the player can return to this point at a later date or if they have Autosave set to greater than 1 turn (which may mean having to repeat some turns if coming back to the game later).

* [b]New Feature:[/b] We have added an information dialog that indicates a unit is a spell casting unit when it is created. It highlights the fact that the unit can [b]Memorize[/b] spells before entering the battlefield. The dialog can be disabled if required.

* [b]New feature:[/b] Improved tooltips on the [b]Rest[/b] and [b]Back to Base[/b] buttons.

The tooltips will now display a list of reasons why the button(s) are disabled. For example, a nearby enemy preventing the party from resting.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41127921/29c8ccf7e81c996c108b4d3be106462e9eb170a6.png[/img]

* [b]New feature:[/b] We have added an attribute [b]Recurring Effects: True[/b] to the Extended Spell Help dialog (invoked when you right click a spell icon or spell help button). This works in conjunction with the tooltips above to help identify any spell that may be preventing a further action (like resting or back to base).

* [b]New feature:[/b] Potions are now more powerful (potent). Previously the spell stored within the potion, for example Cure Serious Wounds, would affect the character as if cast by a level 1 spellcaster.

Now Cantrip and Level 1 spell potions will be cast as if by a level 2 spellcaster. All other spell levels are treated as if a spellcaster was at the minimum level required to cast that spell.

For example, the aforementioned Cure Serious Wounds is a level 4 spell. It requires a spellcaster of level 7 to normally cast this. Thus when a character drinks a [b]Potion of Cure Serious Wounds[/b], the contents will be applied as if a level 7 character had cast it upon the consumer (i.e. the potion will heal a lot more hit points than it did before).

* [b]New feature:[/b] The [b]New Unit Dialog[/b] which is found in the Create Your Party and the Velarin scenes will now issue a warning if you try to recruit a unit that would exceed game limits.

The unit can still be created in case you are intending to dismiss another unit that would bring the total Experience Levels within the limit.

* [b]New feature:[/b] The [b]Unit Dialog[/b], where you find all the information about each unit, will now display flashing messages for things that may require your attention (for example, if you have unused Spell Slots on a unit). This behavior is controlled by a new toggle on the Options > Interface Dialog where you can turn the flashing off if required.

* [b]New feature:[/b] You can now reorder the unit cards anchored to the left side of the screen. There is a new button at the top left of the screen that will invoke a dialog for you to display the cards in whatever order you wish (for example, if you always handle your units in a certain order).

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39203125/766ed7ba1a0d6843fa05dbde896569d056319dba.png[/img]

Note that changing the order of the cards has no effect on the position of your tokens on the battlefield.

* [b]New feature:[/b] We have added a new [b]Advanced Rule[/b] called [b]Experience Overload[/b]. This will allow any of your units to accumulate Experience Points beyond the game limits (although the unit will still be level capped). If the party is then imported into Mystery at Morgoth, the excess points will be applied and the unit will level up immediately.

* [b]New items:[/b] We have added +1 to +5 variants for all of the following normal weapons:

Bardiche, Partisan, Spear, Stabbing Spear, Te yari, Morning Star, Spiked Club, Club, Cutlass, Rapier, Scimitar, Quarterstaff, Short Staff.

* [b]New minor encounters:[/b] Additional enemies have been added to the 'dead' areas of a few maps for those who like to explore the entire map. The scenes affected are:

Darrett's Farm, The Old Mill and Feldar Palace.

Note that scenes that are part completed will not have the encounters.

* [b]Changed spell:[/b] The [b]Breathe Fire[/b] spell has been changed to increase damage (2-3 per level instead of 1-2). This is because it was underpowered compared to comparable spells of the same level.

* [b]Bug fixes:[/b] Quite a number of minor issues that we found in testing that haven't been reported, so hopefully have not affected anybody too much!

This is the first in a number of upgrades where we will retrofit MaM improvements to The Curse. The next release in a month or two will include the new 'Jump Move', so stay tuned for that one.

We hope you enjoy this upgrade and please let us know if you encounter any problems.


All the best.

Ian & Jann

notes.title: Mystery at Morgoth - Released!
notes.content:
Hi Folks.

Finally! Mystery at Morgoth has arrived and we hope it was worth the wait.

Lots of new rules and improvements, some not very nice people that you will have to dispose of (The Cabal) and a story line that links to the final instalment [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1738680/The_Dark_Tower/][b][u]The Dark Tower[/u][/b][/url] (in production - estimated December 2024 - yes, really!)

The following is a list of the new rules/improvements added since [b]The Curse of Feldar Vale[/b]:

[b][u]New Adventure Rules and Features[/u][/b]

Can be accessed when starting a new adventure and at the end of any battle turn.

[list][*]Rule: [b]Chance of Critical Hit[/b] - Do extra damage by striking a vital area of the enemy.[/list]
[list][*]Rule: [b]Chance of Critical Miss[/b] - No matter how easy the target.[/list]
[list][*]Rule: [b]Combat Accuracy[/b] - Sometimes fighting units are just going to miss![/list]
[list][*]Feature: [b]Combat Ticker[/b] - If the Combat Accuracy rule is on, you can display a dialog in the bottom left corner of the screen that shows the 'roll' required to hit and the actual roll and adjustments.[/list]

[u][b]New Advanced Rules[/b][/u]

Can be accessed when starting a new adventure and at the end of any battle turn.

[list][*][b]Static Encounters[/b] - Improved AI gang-rushes if turned off.[/list]
[list][*][b]Death Blow[/b] - Characters have a chance to become Unconscious and/or Bleed Out instead of being killed outright.[/list]
[list][*][b]Allow Multiple Surprise[/b] - Only applies if the 'Chance to Surprise' rule is in effect. If this rule is off, once a unit has been spotted or engaged the enemy it can no longer be surprised by enemies in the vicinity. If the rule is on, a unit can be surprised again after the parties have disengaged and contact is re-initiated.[/list]

[u][b]New Movement Features[/b][/u]

[list][*][b]Jump Move[/b] - The party can immediately move to any point on the map it has previously visited. There are two new options in the Interface options dialog that control the behavior of jump moves (Jump Move Uses Real Time and Confirm Jump Move).[/list]
[list][*][b]Swap Positions[/b] - Player unit tokens can change position (marching order). Can be used at anytime but very useful when in confined spaces. There is a new option in the Player options dialog that controls this behavior (Swap Position Consumes Action).[/list]

[u][b]Other New Features[/b][/u]

[list][*][b]Animate Unit Dialog Messages[/b] - Found in the Interface options dialog. When turned on, will cause information/warning messages in the Unit Dialog to flash so that they are more noticeable.[/list]
[list][*][b]Reorder Unit Cards[/b] - On the battlefield, a new icon at the top left of the screen allows you to swap the positions of the unit cards found on the left edge of the screen. This does not affect the order of the unit tokens on the battlefield.[/list]
[list][*][b]New Unit Warning[/b] - When creating new units, a warning is now displayed if the unit will breach game limits (i.e. experience levels). The unit can still be created as you may want to dismiss a different unit to return within game limits.[/list]
[list][*][b]Auto Allocate Character Points[/b] - For busy people. When you are allocating character points to your units, the Auto Allocate button will do it for you, using the same algorithms it would apply if allocating points to the AI units.[/list]

[u][b]Other Improvements[/b][/u]

[list][*]High definition maps throughout.[/list]
[list][*]Improved Character Generation (change all stats) for new characters.[/list]
[list][*]Variable starting stats for new characters.[/list]
[list][*]Items with Abilities (Sword of Healing, Antivenom Pendant, etc.) Equipping a unit with one of these items will allow the unit to 'use' the abilities/spells within the item. For example, the Antivenom Pendant allows the unit to cast each of the Cure Poison spells once per day.[/list]
[list][*]Improved AI spell casting (with updated [b]Trained and Veteran[/b] AI personalities).[/list]
[list][*]Improved AI combat (with updated [b]Trained and Veteran[/b] AI personalities). For example, AI units may follow when the party attempts to hide or run away.[/list]
[list][*]Trap Descriptions. Many traps will now display a description of what has just happened when a trap is triggered (e.g. "You hear a faint click and suddenly the area is filled with clouds of fungal spores. You have triggered a trap!").[/list]
[list][*]Monster Mechanics. No, not huge folk with hammers! Many new monsters will use attack/defense behaviors not seen in The Curse of Feldar Vale (watch out for those Hydra Snakes!)[/list]


All the Best.

Ian & Jann

notes.title: Update V1.025
notes.content:
Hi All.

Just a small update to add a couple of features, the first of which has been asked for a couple of times by the Community.

[list]
[*][b]New[/b]: [b]One-Way Magic Resistance[/b]

This is a new Advanced Rule setting. When turned on, any units that have [b]Magic Resistance[/b] will not resist a spell that has a [b]Beneficial[/b] effect when it is cast on them. For example Bandage, Cure Light Wounds, etc.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39203125/601b3b5cc66394c981d548060ce25a3e435ba039.png[/img]

Note that spells that provide a unit with explicit protection (e.g. Magic Shield), will still prevent ALL SPELLS.

[*][b]New Combat Sounds[/b]: [b]Punch[/b]

We have added some more realistic sounds for when a unit strikes an enemy with their fists.

[/list]
Please let us know if you have any problems with the update and we hope you enjoy the changed features.

All the best.

Ian & Jann

notes.title: Update V1.023
notes.content:
Hi Folks.

In this update we have changed a couple of behaviors to improve the overall game play and added a new spell.

[list]

notes.title: Update V1.015
notes.content:
Hi All.

This update introduces three new features as requested by the Community and fixes a couple of bugs that we have found during testing.

[list]
[*][b]New Feature[/b]: [b]Weapon Loadouts[/b]

A unit's Inventory page now has a new button available to create/modify weapon loadouts, as shown below.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39203125/fb1368d4bca8c2dad9c6606cf9836d109a1ebbe2.png[/img]

Clicking the button will switch the 'paper doll' display to the display shown in the following image:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39203125/51e42f8ecf3349581524dbd291ef839f92f2fc82.png[/img]

To create a loadout you can either:

a). Drag and drop an item from the Party Backpack to an appropriate slot.
b). Click the Current button on a loadout slot (1) to select the items currently equipped.
c). Drag and drop an item in a loadout to a different slot to 'clone' it to that slot.

Throwing weapons must be unique within the range of loadouts but melee and ranged weapons can feature in multiple loadouts. So, for example, you could create a slot with a Longsword +1 combined with a Spiked Shield +1 (giving an offensive combo as the shield adds extra damage) and another with a Longsword +1 and an Imperial Round Shield +2 (giving a more defensive combo as the shield provides extra protection).

To switch a unit to a new loadout, click the Select button (2) on any slot. Note that if the inventory is locked for any reason, a loadout cannot be selected (the same as a unit cannot be re-equipped if the inventory is locked). You can however still create and/or modify loadouts.

When a loadout is 'selected' the matching items must be available in the Party Backpack. The items will then automatically be equipped on the unit and the items they currently hold are returned to the backpack.

It is possible therefore to have only one of an item in the backpack but create loadouts on two different units with that item. The first unit to 'select' the loadout will get it from the backpack while the button on the other will be inactive as there will no longer be an item in the backpack to fulfill the loadout.

Items that are assigned to loadouts will not be available for sale at the Market. They are effectively 'reserved' to avoid you selling them by accident. The Market Dialog has a new field displayed to inform you of the number of items so reserved, as shown below.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39203125/92089834a0ac27d7585d5bfe05b3d2993309569a.png[/img]

[*][b]New Feature[/b]: [b]Split Movement[/b]

A new Advanced Rule - Unit Movement has been implemented to allow split movement such that any unit can move multiple times during the player's turn (up to the limit of their Movement Points). Combining this rule with the 'Unit Actions' rule will give different challenges as to how the game is played. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39203125/4fc5fed0b155492360a4608af6f579b955ce7268.png[/img]

[*][b]New Feature[/b]: [b]Re-Equipping a Unit After Death[/b]

Units will no longer have their equipment stripped when they die. They will retain all their items and they can be freely equipped/unequipped from/to the Party Backpack at any stage. If a dead unit is dismissed, its equipment will automatically be returned to the Party Backpack.

[*][b]Fixed[/b]: A sneaking unit entering a teleport could cause a program crash. [Internal Bug]

[*][b]Fixed[/b]: When neutral units turn into enemies, their background color does not change as it should. [Internal Bug]

[*][b]Fixed[/b]: After victory, it was sometimes impossible to export the party if it contained a dead unit (exporting from  a battle scene was ok). [Internal Bug]

[*][b]Fixed[/b]: When equipping a weapon from a loot chest, occasionally the unit would not be able to use that weapon until the next turn. [Internal Bug]
[/list]
Please let us know if you have any problems with the update and we hope you enjoy the new features.

All the best.

Ian & Jann

This update adds a new feature from the Feature Changelog, as well as a fix to the game mechanics for weapons with built-in abilities.

[*][b]New Feature[/b]: [b]Compare Tooltip[/b].

With this change you will now be able to select an item on a character's [b]Inventory[/b] page and compare its stats to [b]other usable items of the same type[/b].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39203125/891bd0666cf0d6d8af7fe04a56c49437d3156062.png[/img]

In the picture above you can see that the Power Sword is selected on the paper doll by [b]left clicking the item[/b] and it is outlined in green (1). All items of the same type that are usable by the character are outlined in the Party Backpack in white (2). To compare one of the items in the backpack with the one the character is currently using, [b]hover over the item in the backpack[/b] and the [b]Compare Tooltip[/b] will be displayed as shown in the picture below.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39203125/056aebe59887d32ce20bcf4fbcdb1d21b6771302.png[/img]

The values shown indicate the improvements to a character when the item is equipped (3) as well as the difference when compared to the other item (4). The Special Features section (5) displays any built-in ability that the item possesses.

You can also use the feature in reverse by left clicking an item in the [b]Party Backpack[/b] as shown.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39203125/bee36898715fc9df7d2ec476781bc2ff42cedd69.png[/img]

In this case you can compare the item with a similar one that is already equipped or you can compare two items that are in the backpack with each other.

Please note that the [b]Compare Tooltip[/b] is currently only available on the unit's [b]Inventory[/b] page. We have added a task to the Feature Changelog to roll out the change to other dialogs. We also intend to improve the Special Features section (5) of the tooltip to display built-in attribute improvements (e.g. +10 Scouting) as well as built-in abilities (e.g. Shock).

We have also improved the standard tooltip when hovering over a weapon to indicate the actual damage it will do when equipped based on the character's choice of [b]Weapon Specialization[/b].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39203125/1d91c8c579bb27d53571fb085c86490e7ae1d317.png[/img]

[*][b]Fixed[/b]: Damage displayed when using a weapon with a built-in ability, for example the Power Sword, was +1 greater than the actual damage caused.
[/list]
Please let us know if you have any problems with the update and we hope you enjoy the new features. Next up is the [b]Weapons Loadout[/b] feature which we are designing at the moment.

All the best.

Ian & Jann

notes.content:
Hi All.

This latest release features a number of small updates that have been requested by the Community plus one of our own, as well as a bug fix and a minor improvement to the Search Dialog.
[list]

[*] [b]New Feature[/b]: [b]Method to Manually Snap Camera to Player Unit[/b].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39203125/a45920b8aed1e96e00d0cc5c49952531a7cc813d.png[/img]

We have added a new parameter to the Player Options that allows you to 'snap' the camera to a unit and override the 'Center Camera on Selected Unit' option. This allows you to move to/locate a unit that is off-screen with a single right-click on its Unit Card.

[*] [b]New Feature[/b]: [b]Faster 'Recovered' Messages[/b].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39203125/1b156f367732e4c71cb44429b1d0960c7aeacd60.png[/img]

A new parameter in the Interface Options allows you to decide whether the messages that appear on your units when they recover at end of turn will be 'Staggered' or 'Simultaneous'. Note that in the latter case messages will overlap when units are close together.

[*] [b]New Feature[/b]: [b]Easier 'Back to Base'[/b].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39203125/17e0a721f7abebe16343fd7358be319802375ee7.png[/img]

A new Advanced Rule has been added to allow your party to return to base more easily. The rules for allowing the party to return to base are more stringent than those that allow the party to rest. This is to provide for more of a challenge in the game play. When this option is turned on, [b]Rest[/b] and [b]Back to Base[/b] follow the same rules. If the party can rest, it can go back to base.

[*] [b]New Feature[/b]: [b]Option to Cancel Group Movement if Enemy Moves Into Sight[/b].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39203125/f12905267cd20f7789d1f308edb404c9883169ac.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39203125/537c06558a482b255e6a70bda1bfc97e1ce9d3d8.png[/img]

A new dropdown has been implemented on the Party Backpack when you are viewing a character's inventory. By default the new filter is set to 'Usable' so that only the items a unit can use are shown. This should significantly improve the drill-down to items when you want to change inventory.

[*] [b]Fixed[/b]: Resolved an issue where [b]Ability Charges[/b] (bought from the [b]Training Hall[/b]), were not resetting at midnight during combat if the End of Turn dialog is turned off. [Community reported bug]

notes.title: Patch V1.007
notes.content:
Hi Folks.

We are delighted to announce the release of the most requested new feature and a bug fix.

[list]

[*] [b]New Feature[/b]: [b]Group Movement[/b].

We have implemented a basic 'follow the leader' style of group movement which we hope will make moving the party across large distances more speedy and less tiresome.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39203125/3eac14867fa609324540b68ffd9b99a21d02e6e8.png[/img]

Toggle the movement using the new button on the battlefield UI as indicated above. Move a single unit and the rest will try to follow it.

Note that this is still 'turn-based' so is not designed to just move the party from point A to a distant point B in one go. It should however, speed up movement by up to 6 times. We have found that the system is still very useful in confined spaces but please be aware that multiple passages/doors can lead to what might seem an illogical move by the occasional unit. It is also not intended to be a 'formation' move, so the exact positioning of each unit will vary.

We have implemented some [b]Group Movement Options[/b] which can be accessed via the Main Menu Options or Screen Menu Options dialogs (see below).

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39203125/89b520c18c82644cee03373bcf3c4fcbfbc85109.png[/img]

Either of these new buttons will display the following dialog:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39203125/39952d70a3a84d5c3324b6664a36a086bded7706.png[/img]

There is a good degree of 'help' available on this screen to explain the mechanics of group movement. 

We will look to improve the movement in future updates, for example being able to move two groups of units independently on the same map level. For now we hope the new feature will improve your game play experience.

[*] [b]Fixed[/b]: Corrected Experience Point Allocation under certain circumstances when using 'pooling'. Any accumulated experience should automatically allocate on the next game turn and then accrue correctly thereafter. [Internal bug]

[/list]
Please let us know if you have any problems with this patch and we hope you enjoy the new feature.

All the best.

Ian & Jann

notes.title: Patch V1.005
notes.content:
Hi All.

just to let you know that we have uploaded a patch for a couple of new features, changes and bug fixes:

[list]
[*] [b]New Feature[/b]: [b]Experience Allocation[/b]. 

Set by a new set of options on the [b]Advanced Rules[/b] dialog.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39203125/725573796173ff5b7d958309ff33bad62b4c42a4.png[/img]

By setting these options you can decide how you want to allocate any experience that the units generate. You can even change it from turn to turn if you want to.

The values for Experience Allocation (new option 1) are:

[b]Actions[/b] - This is the default and the way the game works at the moment. Only units that do anything gain experience (attacking, casting spells, sneaking, etc.)

[b]Actions and Pooled[/b] - When a unit gains experience, a percentage of the gain will be allocated to an [b]Experience Pool[/b] for sharing across all party members. The percentage is set using the slider (new option 2) with the value selected going to the pool and the rest to the unit.

[b]Pooled[/b] - When a unit gains experience, all of it will be allocated to an [b]Experience Pool[/b] for sharing across all party members.

Experience in the pool is shared out at the end of every turn and any left over remains in the pool until the next turn. If using the pooling options, a new icon/value pair will appear in the [b]Selection Bar[/b] at the top of the screen (see screenshot below). The value indicated is the amount of experience currently in the pool.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39203125/46d004a58b6f15e33a51ce059109f246aefe991e.png[/img]

Each time the pool is increased/decreased you can choose to have the value 'float' from the new icon (new option 3).

Please note that as the sharing is done at end of turn, events that do not trigger a turn ('Resting' and 'Back to Base') will not allocate the experience which will carry over to the next battle turn (on any map). We will improve this in a future update.

[*] [b]New Feature[/b]: [b]Unit Card Stats[/b].

When displaying the unit cards (left side of the battlefield, Create Your Party scene, Party Management), you can choose to have the key stats shown as bars (the default) or numbers. The feature is actioned by a new dropdown on the Options > [b]Interface[/b] dialog shown below:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39203125/3d3e2d0d2d349df0bc55191c01cbd833e6ee6b7b.png[/img]

The image below shows the two ways that the unit card can be displayed.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39203125/d6417611ece179be024b178f06acf5c28db5a359.png[/img]


[*] [b]Changed[/b]: We have increased the font size of any text that 'floats' from UI elements (like the [b]Selection Bar[/b] and the [b]Loot Dialog[/b]) to make it more noticeable.

[*] [b]Changed[/b]: Increased the availability of scrolls in the market at Velarin.

[*] [b]Fixed[/b]: It was possible for enemy units to top-out experience in the same manner as player units. Player units are limited to maximum level 6 in this game (see the Create Your Party and Party Management screens). Enemy units are never limited in leveling up. [Internal bug]

[*] [b]Fixed[/b]: Magical Splint Mail+1 to +5 were all named as +1. Stats were correct, the displayed name was wrong. [Internal bug]

[/list]
Please let us know if you have any problems with this patch and we hope you enjoy the new features.

All the best.

Ian & Jann

notes.title: Good News and Bad News
notes.content:
Hi All.

Thought it was about time for another update in which we have some Good News and some Bad News.

First the Bad....we are going to have to delay the launch a bit as progress in the last few weeks has been more difficult than expected. Additionally, the link between The Curse and the next title Mystery at Morgoth (MaM) is proving a tad more complicated than expected. We have to ensure that when we launch The Curse that you will be able to export your party to MaM.

The slippage is going to push the launch too close to the Steam Summer Sale and all advice suggests that we should wait until after the sale to ensure decent visibility. Currently we are looking at some time in July for the re-scheduled launch. Apologies for the delay but obviously we want to make sure everything is right!

Now the Good....we have been able to implement a couple of extra suggestions from the Community.

- Options screens will now be easier to read.
- The party character profiles can now be cycled forward by using the TAB key.
- You can set the background color for each of your units separately.

We have also added:

- A new option to the Interface Options dialog to add some very basic Ambience Lighting to the battle scenes. This will hopefully add a touch more atmosphere to the battles as the day/night cycle transitions.
- Fifteen plus new portraits to choose when customizing your party.
- A new filter on the Choose Portrait Dialog to filter by gender.

All of the above changes will be available in the latest Demo Update V0.138 which we are releasing with this announcement.

By necessity we have had to make a start on MaM to prove the link between the two titles (which should also prove the link to the final title in the series The Dark Tower [i]working title[/i]). We have already sketched out the storyboard for MaM, generated the interface and designed the maps for the first location. So if all goes to plan we will be launching MaM around November time (Steam page to go live soon) and The Dark Tower will be scheduled for a March 2022 release.

We also hope to improve the engine on each successive title by adding extra Options or Advanced Rules that will bring new features to the series (as well as new spells, new items and a shed-load of new monsters!)

That's about all for now. Thanks for reading and please let us know if you have any feedback.

All the Best and Stay Safe!

Ian & Jann

notes.title: Welcome!
notes.content:
Hi All.

Welcome to the Community Hub for our latest game [b]The Curse of Feldar Vale[/b] (Curse).

For our first bit of news we thought we would highlight some differences in this game compared to [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/957570/The_Qaedon_Wars__The_Story_Begins/][b]The Qaedon Wars[/b][/url] which we have used as a base engine.
[list]
[*]Curse has a [b]Quest[/b] system rather than Objectives per battle, with each quest forming part of the background story. Some are optional and others must be completed to finish the game.

[*]Game play is non-linear, so quests do not have to be completed in a specific order.

[*][b]Time[/b] plays a significant role in Curse with a real-world clock, Day/Night cycle and so on.

[*]Your 'army' is limited to a party of maximum 6 characters and 8 starting levels. Multi-class characters count 1 level per class.

[*]We have introduced the [b]Battlemage[/b] class which utilizes [b]Planar[/b] magic (only the enemy had this in Qaedon).

[*]In a similar way to D&D, [b]Spellcasters[/b] now have to [b]Memorize[/b] their spells before battle. Mages/Battlemages have limited spells to choose from and must acquire new spells from scrolls. Clerics have all spells available to choose from.

[*][b]Resting[/b] the party allows your spellcasters to change their spells ready for the next encounter, as well as allowing all party members to recover Hit Points and Mana points. Note that you won't always be able to rest when you want to (a band of orcs nearby would make sleeping a bit tricky!)

[*]Your party has to be [b]Supplied[/b]. Keep an eye on your rations or combat performance will start to suffer!

[*]The party shares an inventory (the Party Backpack), making inventory management much easier.

[*]Inventory items are grouped by item, so 10 swords will appear as 1 with a counter against the unit.

[*][b]Flying[/b] units can now be attacked in melee (watch out for the [b]Advanced Fliers[/b] rule coming in the next game [b]Mystery at Morgoth[/b] which will make fliers more interesting!)

[*]On the battlefield, [b]Height[/b] plays an important role with each 'step' difference between an attacking and defending unit increasing the attack by +10%. For example, a unit standing on a table (H1) will cause 10% more damage to a unit on the floor (H0).

[*]Terrain type has little importance in Curse. Each unit has up to 4 different movement speeds (similar to D&D). These are Land/Air/Water/Formless.

[*][b]Clerics[/b] can now [b]Turn[/b] the Undead. The mechanics are very similar to D&D with chances of success based on the level of the Cleric and the type and level of the Undead foes.
[/list]

Hope that's enough for now to 'whet your appetite'. We'll post more info on some of the other changes in the near future.

Cheers and Stay Safe!

Ian & Jann
